explanation: Judo, founded in Japan in 1882, joined the programme when Tokyo hosted the 1964 Games. Korea's taekwondo was a demonstration sport in 1988 and won medal status at Sydney 2000.

claims.text: Judo became an Olympic medal sport at the 1964 Tokyo Games.
Taekwondo became an Olympic medal sport at the 2000 Sydney Games.
Judo was founded in Japan by Kanō Jigorō in 1882.
Taekwondo was a demonstration sport at the 1988 Seoul Olympics.
